svg.title: A prior that rules values out
svg.desc: A flat prior on rates from 0.80 to 1.00 with zero density below, a likelihood peaking at 0.62, and a posterior pressed against the 0.80 boundary.
svg.text: A zero in the prior is permanent
Cap seal test: 31 of 50 caps passed, sample proportion 0.62
The product of a zero prior and any likelihood is zero, so no amount of data can move mass below 0.80.
The model was in trouble before it was fitted: this prior expected about 45 of 50 caps to pass.
